annotation.interpretation_a: The receiver must stop sending immediate ACKs for in-order packets after 1/8 RTT, even if no out-of-order packets have arrived.
annotation.interpretation_b: The receiver must stop sending immediate ACKs for in-order packets after 1/8 RTT *if* out-of-order packets have not arrived, but may continue if they have.
annotation.justification: The phrase "unless more out-of-order packets arrive" modifies "SHOULD NOT exceed 1/8 RTT" but it is unclear if the limit is conditional on the arrival of out-of-order packets, or if the limit is always in effect unless out-of-order packets *prevent* it.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not clearly state whether the 1/8 RTT limit applies regardless of whether out-of-order packets arrive, or only when they do not. This affects the duration of sending immediate ACKs for in-order packets.
